# Transform

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Each feature rotated (degrees clockwise), scaled about its centroid or bounding-box center, then moved a distance along a compass bearing, as turf.transformRotate, transformScale and transformTranslate.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{ "id": "n1", "op": "transform", "name": "transform", "x": 0, "y": 0, "params": {} }
```

An edge into it ends at `"targetPort": "in"`; one out of it starts at `"sourcePort": "out"`; a parameter is set in `params` (leave out the ones at their default), driven by an edge to `par:rotate`, or read elsewhere as `ch('transform/rotate')`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
| Port | Type | Takes |
|------|------|-------|
| `in` | `table` | one edge |
<!-- gen:end inputs -->

## Parameters

<!-- gen:begin params -->
| Parameter | Kind | Default | Choices |
|-----------|------|---------|---------|
| `rotate` | `float` | `0` |  |
| `scale` | `float` | `1` |  |
| `distance` | `float` | `0` |  |
| `direction` | `float` | `0` |  |
| `units` | `menu` | `"kilometers"` | `kilometers`, `meters`, `miles`, `nauticalmiles`, `feet`, `degrees` |
| `origin` | `menu` | `"centroid"` | `centroid`, `center` |
<!-- gen:end params -->

## Outputs

<!-- gen:begin outputs -->
| Port | Type |
|------|------|
| `out` | `table` |
<!-- gen:end outputs -->
